CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 42
   D. 36

2. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x = 5
   D. x > 5

3. Solve for x: x + 4 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 8
   C. 4
   D. 9

4. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 82
   C. 9
   D. 81

5. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 13
   C. 41
   D. 40

6. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 156

7. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

8. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 25
   C. 11
   D. 5

9. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 24

10. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 13
   C. 37
   D. 5

11. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 81

12. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 13
   C. 17
   D. 7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — 36
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 6 × 6
3. Area = 36
Final Answer: 36 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. D — x > 5

3. B — 8
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: x = RHS − constant
2. Substitute values: x = 12 − 4
3. x = 8
Final Answer: x = 8
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

4. D — 81
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 9² = 9 × 9
3. 9² = 81
Final Answer: 81
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

5. D — 40
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Product = first factor × second factor
2. Substitute values: Product = 8 × 5
3. Product = 40
